title: Python: B.2.1 Small Bounded Queues
description:
Implement 4-packet TX queue, 2-per-source forwarding, 8-msg BLE GATT limits with QueueFull error returns.

## MUST/SHALL Checklist (from spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md)

### Queue Bounds
- [ ] TX queue: 4 packets max
- [ ] Forwarding buffer: 2 packets per source max
- [ ] Forwarding sources: 8 max (total 16 packets)
- [ ] BLE GATT: 8 messages max

### Backpressure Behavior
- [ ] When queue full, return error (ENOBUFS/QueueFull) to local sender
- [ ] When forwarding full per-source, send NACK upstream
- [ ] MUST NOT silently queue or tail-drop when full
- [ ] Return explicit signals rather than hiding congestion

### Implementation Notes
- `tx_queue_push()` returns -ENOBUFS when full
- Per-source limits prevent one chatty node from monopolizing relay
close_reason:
All B.2.1 Small Bounded Queues requirements already implemented and tested:
- TX queue: 4 packets max (tx_queue.py:TX_QUEUE_CAPACITY=4)
- Forwarding: 2/source, 8 sources max (forwarding_buffer.py)
- BLE GATT: 8 messages max (gatt.py:MAX_QUEUE_DEPTH=8)
- Backpressure: QueueFullError, BACKPRESSURE result, on_drop callbacks
- No silent drops: explicit signals on all drop paths
All 4 child issues closed, 152 tests pass.
